scale: One UV unit = one meter; heights stored in meters. Height-to-normal converts both UVs and heights to millimeters at scale 16.
visualReview: Parent hardware preview exposed coherent weave moire on cotton sphere/totem. Revised yarn phase jitter, microgeometry amplitude and statistical fiber treatment; parent rerenders final.
limitations: Fine cloth preserves true mean yarn pitch while using primarily statistical directional microfibers and a low-contrast phase-jittered residual weave to control distant moire.
Sheen and anisotropy approximate microfibers; geometry does not model actual flyaway fibers or pile silhouette.
Decorative print motifs are original procedural interpretations. Scenic toile uses a repeated cottage/tree landscape.
Height-to-normal is the documented renderer workaround; cross-renderer normal response depends on implementation.
friction: No connected mtlx MCP tool; instantiated repository stdio server through MCP SDK.
